subject: [OrchardWay] Solution fit & architecture review for Redwood integration
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@orchardway.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Devon Lee <devon.lee@orchardway.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrchardWay <> Redwood - Solution fit & architecture review

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the intro last week. OrchardWay has a product-line (OrchardFlow) that routes structured customer data into multiple downstream inference providers; we think Redwood's unified runtime could be a stronger partner for our LLM execution layer.

I've attached a short reference draft that shows how OrchardFlow would call Redwood (orchardway-redwood-reference-draft.pdf). High level highlights:
- Two integration options: 1) Managed API (hosted) using per-request auth; 2) VPC peering to a dedicated Redwood pool (for higher throughput & data residency).
- Expected peak: ~600 concurrent requests, average 1.2k tokens/request, 95th latency target < 350ms per token under bursty load.
- Data classification: PII-stripped, but requires EU-data residency for some customers (we're starting with US pilot).

We'd like to schedule a 60-minute architecture review next week with your infra/partner engs to validate the reference flow and smoke-test plan. Proposed agenda:
1) Integration options & auth patterns
2) Network/residency implications (VPC vs Hosted)
3) Performance sizing (batching, KV cache usage, quantization tradeoffs)
4) Smoke test / canary plan and success criteria

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join? Also, we have an env spec CSV and a short CSV of baseline payload sizes — I attached the specs; happy to share a Drive folder.

Thanks,

Sasha Ivanov
Head of Platform Partnerships
OrchardWay Solutions
attachment: orchardway-redwood-reference-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 480KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@orchardway.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OrchardWay <> Redwood - Solution fit & architecture review

Sasha — thanks for the concise deck and draft flow, this looks promising. Karthik (runtime) and Marissa (partner eng) are looped in. Proposed time slots: Tue 2026-09-01 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2026-09-02 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for you?

Quick notes ahead of the call (so we can use time for tradeoffs and sizing):
- Auth: if you choose Hosted, we'll expect token-based service accounts; for Private/Dedicated we typically recommend mTLS+IAM federation for long-lived traffic. Helpful if you can share expected token-per-minute rates and TTL needs.
- VPC & peering: we need CIDR ranges and whether you need bi-directional routing for health checks. If you want Private deployment, we'll need an onboarding questionnaire (we can send a stub).
- Performance: please include a short sample of payloads and tokenized length distribution (p50/p90/p99). That lets runtime pick kernel & quantization profile.
- Success criteria: suggest we define 3 smoke test vectors: baseline throughput, cold-start latency, and long-sequence stability (KV cache hit-rate > 85% for repeated prompts).

I've attached a short scope note (rw-initial-scope-notes.md) — it's a living doc. If you can also drop the env CSV into the Drive folder you mentioned that will help.

Agenda draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchardway-redwood (I'll add a short meeting brief after we lock time).

Best,

--
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0128

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OrchardWay <> Redwood - Solution fit & architecture review

Thanks Mina — Tue 09/01 10:00 PT works for us. We'll plan for a 60-minute technical readout.

Answers to the quick items you called out:
- Auth: For the Hosted pilot we'll use short-lived tokens (1 hour TTL) minted by our platform; for Dedicated we'd prefer mTLS+OIDC federation (we can provide certs). Average token calls: ~8k/min during peak (per-region).
- Network: we can provide an allowlist CIDR and support VPC peering with static NAT for health checks. No inbound health-check ports from Redwood are required — we initiate all connections.
- Payloads: attached orchardway-env-specs.csv with representative payload sizes and p50/p90 tokenized distribution. Typical payloads are short (system + user ~ 400 tokens) but batch inference spikes to >1k for long-document summarization.
- Priority success criteria: baseline throughput of 300 req/s sustained for 5 minutes with p95 latency < 500ms; KV cache hit improvement target > 80% for repeated prompts.

We'll also add a short compliance note about EU residency for later phases. Drive folder link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchardway-redwood — inside you'll find the CSV and a rough topology diagram.

Attachments: orchardway-env-specs.csv (text/csv, 12KB)

Looking forward to the call. If there's anything you want Karthik to pre-read (kernel/quantization notes), flag it and we'll send over a short tech appendix.

Cheers,
Sasha

All — confirmed for Tue 2026-09-01 10:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invite sent; agenda doc updated with meeting owners and expected artifacts.

Pre-meeting asks (so we can move fast):
- Sasha/OrchardWay: please upload the env CSV and a small sample payload set to the Drive folder and add an example API key rotation cadence note. We'll use those to run a local tokenized distribution analysis before the call.
- Karthik: please prepare a one-page tech appendix that covers kernel selection heuristics, recommended quantization profiles for 8-bit vs 4-bit, and a short note on batching strategies for bursty traffic.
- Marissa: please draft a short canary runbook template (steps, rollback criteria, metrics to collect) — we can adapt it for OrchardWay during the meeting.

Action items (owners):
- OrchardWay (Sasha): upload files and confirm EU-residency requirements for phase 2 (by Mon EOD 2026-08-31).
- Redwood (Mina): prepare onboarding questionnaire and proposed Dedicated sizing ranges (by Mon EOD 2026-08-31).
- Redwood (Karthik/Marissa): tech appendix + canary runbook (by Tue start-of-day).

I'll attach the short onboarding questionnaire to the Drive folder now; see: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchardway-redwood

Looking forward — this looks like a good cross-company pilot.

Best,

--
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
